purpose: Teach: 小田/富田/天野/遠山/篠原/藤村/須藤/牧野

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、小田刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Oda's on-scene response has earned quite a bit of recognition too, hasn't it?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, collaborative tone. Steady pace, respectful. Nodding along as if taking notes on a shared understanding of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人富田氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: You've been carefully gathering statements from the witness, Tomita, I understand.
lines.style: Gentle check-in, conversational. Light on the formality despite the police procedural context. Curious, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者天野氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And the victim's family, the Amano family—you've been looking after them through this.
lines.style: Softer inflection here. Acknowledging the human weight of the work. Slower pace, slight sympathetic breath before continuing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者遠山氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: You've been working through the witness Toyama's statement carefully.
lines.style: Professional but warm. Even rhythm. Recognition without fanfare. The tone of someone who sees the meticulous work happening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者篠原の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And you've confirmed the suspect Shinohara's prior record.
lines.style: Factual, steady. No judgment in the delivery. Matter-of-fact but still collegial in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識藤村主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: You and Fujimura, the forensics lead, have gone through the scene together.
lines.style: Acknowledging partnership. Collaborative warmth. Slight emphasis on the teamwork. Steady, professional pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士須藤様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: You've gotten some guidance from the psychologist, Sudo, as well.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Light, acknowledging outside expertise. Unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の牧野様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And you're in pre-trial consultation with the prosecutor Makino too.
lines.style: Slightly more formal here, recognition of a larger process. Still warm, but a touch more measured. The scope widening in the delivery.
